nodes.description: SafeMath library function mul(uint256 _a, uint256 _b) internal pure that multiplies with an overflow revert check.
SafeMath library function div(uint256 _a, uint256 _b) internal pure that reverts when the divisor is zero.
SafeMath library function sub(uint256 _a, uint256 _b) internal pure that reverts on underflow.
SafeMath library function add(uint256 _a, uint256 _b) internal pure that reverts on overflow.
SafeMath library function mod(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure that reverts on division by zero.
Public view function returning the private state variable totalSupply_.
Public view function returning balances[_owner].
Public view function returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Public function transferring _value tokens from msg.sender to _to, updating balances and emitting Transfer.
Public function setting allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emitting Approval.
Public function transferring tokens from _from to _to using the caller's allowance and updating balances/allowed.
Public function increasing the caller's allowance for _spender by _addedValue.
Public function decreasing the caller's allowance for _spender by _subtractedValue, floored at zero.
Internal function minting _amount tokens to _account and increasing totalSupply_.
Internal function burning _amount tokens from _account and decreasing totalSupply_.
Internal function burning tokens from _account after deducting the caller's allowance, then calling _burn.
Constructor that mints the entire INITIAL_SUPPLY of 400 million tokens to msg.sender via _mint.
Private mapping(address => uint256) tracking token balances of each holder.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) tracking allowances.
Private uint256 holding the total token supply.
Public constant string token name 'Melior'.
Public constant string token symbol 'MEL'.
Public constant uint8 token decimals value 18.
Public constant uint256 initial supply of 400000000 * 10**18 tokens.
Caller address used in transfer as the source of funds and balance key.

Caller address used in transferFrom as the spender whose allowance is checked and decremented.

Deployer address that receives the entire initial token supply.
